description: perihelion-epoch disagreement between independently fitted inbound and outbound legs on raw MPC astrometry; boundary products joined from the step_b91 checkpoint
conditioning: both leg osculating tp within one total arc of the SBDB seed tp; near-parabolic fits outside that window carry an unbounded M/n inversion and are excluded from tests
reading: T1 certifies the channel: the perihelion-epoch disagreement is a projection of the same inter-leg non-closure the angular record carries, so it must concord with |dtau| and ddirf.  T2/T3 test whether the timing slip carries the same cap localization and bipolar polarity; T4 checks whether it survives residualization against astrometric-noise covariates.
